events.title: Demo 1.7: The Homeowners Have Arrived!
events.summary: Hi everyone! Steam Next Fest has begun, and we've brought our biggest demo update yet. The biggest change: the houses aren't empty anymore, the homeowners are waiting for you! HighlightsHomeowners: They greet you on every job and watch the whole move. They react instantly to items hitting walls, broken parts and thrown boxes. events.title: Demo Update: Smoother Carrying, Higher FPS
events.summary: Hi everyone! Thank you to everyone who played the demo and left a review. Most of you mentioned physics bugs, stuttering and how hard carrying felt, so this update is built entirely around that. Highlights Smoother carrying: Your grip no longer breaks during two-player carrying, and items no longer clip into your body or snag on the ground. events.title: We Hit 10,000 Wishlists — Thank You!
events.summary: Carry On Together just reached 10,000 wishlists on Steam! As a small indie team, your support means the world to us — thank you for every single wishlist!See you at Steam Next Fest (October 19–26) with our demo!

events.title: Welcome, Russia and Kazakhstan!
events.summary: We're thrilled to see so many new players from Russia and Kazakhstan wishlisting Carry On Together!Thanks for joining us — you're now part of a community that will haul furniture with friends, cause chaos, and try not to break everything along the way.We'll be showing off a playable demo very soon at Steam Next Fest. If you haven't wishlisted yet, it helps us out a lot!

events.title: Thank You for 1,000 Wishlists!
